d: Short, wavy ash-blonde hair peeks from beneath a hat, framing a mature, middle-aged face with glowing, featureless white eyes. The slender build is dressed in a sage-green overcoat over a white dress shirt, a red patterned necktie, dark brown pinstriped trousers with suspenders, and two-tone brown and white oxfords. A matching sage-green fedora with a red band sits atop the head, while the outfit is accented by a red fringed scarf draped over one arm and a purple flower pinned to the lapel. Signature accessories include dark grey gloves and a thin wooden walking cane held in the left hand, with splashes of vibrant blue and purple paint staining the right shoulder and lower legs.
